statements.impact_statement: GO-2026-5932 covers golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp, deprecated and unmaintained, with no fixed version (it now ships as its own module at v0.1.0-deprecated). In kratos the only importer is github.com/google/go-github/v38/github, used by the GitHub OIDC providers (selfservice/strategy/oidc/provider_github.go, provider_github_app.go). go-github uses openpgp only in createSignature (github/git_commits.go:154-166), which Git.CreateCommit calls when a commit carries a SigningKey. kratos calls only Users.Get and Users.ListEmails (provider_github.go:76, :95; provider_github_app.go:64, :82), so no openpgp code runs. The recipe fails the build if any other package imports openpgp or if the OIDC strategy calls more of go-github's Git API. Checked 2026-11-11 against kratos 26.2.0.
